ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against EU Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, French National Asset Freeze Register (Registre national des gels - TRACFIN), and World Bank Debarment List. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) required for any UBO or legal representative identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) per CMF Article R.561-18. Screening must be repeated annually and upon any trigger event. AML/CFT risk-based approach per CMF Articles L.561-2 to L.561-8. Reporting obligations to TRACFIN (Traitement du renseignement et action contre les circuits financiers clandestins) for suspicious transactions per CMF Article L.561-15. Record retention for 5 years after termination of business relationship per CMF Article L.561-12.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique (https://www.inpi.fr/guichet-unique) and Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Infogreffe (https://www.infogreffe.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French language is mandatory for company name registration per Loi n° 94-665 du 4 août 1994 relative à l'emploi de la langue française (Loi Toubon). Article L.123-1 of the Code de commerce requires the company name to be in French. Foreign-language names are permitted only with an official French translation filed simultaneously. Transliteration from non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) must be certified by a sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) registered with the Cour d'appel. The name must not infringe prior trademarks per Code de la propriété intellectuelle Articles L.711-1 et seq. The name must be distinctive and not deceptive or misleading.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection by INPI, the applicant may file a recours gracieux (administrative appeal) with the Directeur Général de l'INPI within 2 months of notification. If rejected, a recours contentieux (judicial appeal) may be filed before the Tribunal judiciaire de Paris within 2 months of the final administrative decision. For conflicts with prior trademarks, opposition proceedings may be initiated before the INPI within 2 months of publication of the trademark application. The applicant may also negotiate a coexistence agreement with the prior rights holder. Name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30-day period upon written request to INPI with justification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for SAS registration in France provided the address is a real commercial premises with a domiciliation agreement (contrat de domiciliation) from a registered domiciliataire approved by the Préfecture per Code de commerce Articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-3 and Décret n° 2017-1094. For the silicone fidget manufacturing industry (ISIC 3240), a virtual office is not acceptable for the manufacturing activity itself; a physical production site is required for regulatory and customs compliance. However, the registered office may be domiciled at a virtual office if the manufacturing is outsourced to a third-party contractor with a separate physical facility. The domiciliation agreement must be filed with the RCS and includes the domiciliataire's liability for compliance with AML/CFT obligations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (75-90%) for manufacturing entities due to DREETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) and CARSAT (Caisse d'assurance retraite et de la santé au travail) workplace safety inspections, customs audits by Douane Française, and DGCCRF (Direction générale de la concurrence, de la consommation et de la répression des fraudes) product safety compliance checks for food-grade silicone tactile sensory fidgets under EU Regulation 1935/2004 and EU Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC. Unannounced inspections may occur within the first 12 months of operation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L. 227-1 to L. 227-20 (SAS); Civil Code for contract formalities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) – Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and Déclaration de Non-Condamnation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for SAS; capital freely determined in statuts. If capital > €0, deposit funds in a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) and obtain bank certificate. Minimum issued capital typically €1.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company hereby accepts the subscription of [Number] shares by [Shareholder Name] for a total consideration of [Amount], and that such shares be fully paid up. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be established at [Address]. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed as Président (Chairman) and [Name] as Directeur Général (General Manager), each for an indefinite term, with authority to act on behalf of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Président is authorized to file all necessary documents with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and drafting of statuts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) for name availability; notary or lawyer for statuts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct name search on INPI database; draft statuts in French; sign by all shareholders.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name rejected, submit alternative name with evidence of distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bank or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked account (compte bloqué), deposit capital, obtain bank certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank refuses, use Caisse des Dépôts or provide notarized attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with RCS via Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce – Guichet Unique (formalities.gouv.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit application via Guichet Unique, upload statuts, bank certificate, declaration of non-conviction, and proof of address.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, respond within 15 days with corrected documents; appeal to court if rejected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL); INSEE for SIRET; URSSAF for social security.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish notice of incorporation in a JAL within 8 days of registration; obtain SIRET automatically after RCS registration; register with URSSAF and tax authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIRET delayed, contact INSEE with proof of RCS filing; if publication omitted, publish immediately and provide proof.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with ICPE Rubrique 2661: VOC emissions < 2 t/year; wastewater pre-treatment for silicone residues; waste code 07 02 99 disposal via approved channels; noise levels < 70 dB(A) at property boundary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours); structural load inspection by certified engineer; workplace clearance from Inspection du Travail (Labour Inspection) for occupational safety and health compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) at impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French-resident entities receive automatic SIREN/SIRET assignment upon registration with the Chambre de Commerce and DGFiP; foreign entities must apply directly to DGFiP for statutory TIN and VAT ID when establishing French operations or branches
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; classification follows legal form. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD Directive apply to certain cross-border structures

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 77,700 euros annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time facturation électronique with API reporting to DGFiP; digital time-stamping (horodatage) required for all invoices and clearance

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported outside the EU or services supplied to non-EU customers, requiring proof of export and non-EU destination
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT, interest surcharges, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rated amounts

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BDF) and Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking supervision; Direction Générale du Trésor for exchange control policy; European Central Bank (ECB) for monetary policy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: EUR is fully convertible under Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement. France maintains no capital account restrictions for EU-resident entities. For non-resident shareholders, profit remittance is unrestricted after corporate tax declaration and payment. However, outbound transfers exceeding EUR 100,000 to non-EU jurisdictions may trigger AML/CFT reporting under Article L.561-1 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. Routine dividend distributions require documentation of shareholder resolution and tax clearance (if applicable).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender requirement. French exporters may retain foreign currency proceeds in domestic or offshore accounts. Repatriation is not compulsory. However, for statistical reporting, cross-border payments exceeding EUR 125,000 must be reported to Banque de France via the 'Déclaration de Mouvements de Capitaux' (DMC) system within 20 working days. Failure to report may incur administrative fines.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMIs such as Wise, Revolut Business, and Qonto are viable for operational accounts but generally restricted for capital escrow or large-volume trade settlements due to limited deposit insurance and prudential oversight. Cross-border EMI accounts for a French SAS are feasible for low-value inbound/outbound payments, but Tier 1 banks remain mandatory for capital injection and LC issuance. Legal constraints: EMIs must be licensed as 'Établissement de Paiement' by ACPR. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Payoneer) are accepted only for platform payouts, subject to FATF-compliant AML policies.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For standard corporate accounts, French banks require at least one beneficial owner or director to attend an in-person interview at the branch. Remote onboarding is permitted only for SAS with fully verified French residency and digital identity (e.g., via FranceConnect). Non-resident directors without French tax residency must typically appear physically or appoint a local representative with notarized power of attorney. Video-KYC is accepted by some fintechs but not by Tier 1 banks for initial capital escrow accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) from a FATF grey-list jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport, proof of residential address, notarized UBO declaration, source of funds affidavit, and a letter from a reputable law firm confirming no adverse media.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex ownership structure with nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full chain of ownership chart, shareholder register, trust deeds (if any), and a legal opinion from French counsel confirming compliance with Article L.233-3 of the Commercial Code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification (e.g., crypto, arms, gambling).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business license, end-user certificates, and detailed explanation of product end-use. For silicone fidgets, provide material safety data sheets (MSDS) and food-grade certification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent cross-border transfers to tax havens.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transfer pricing documentation, intercompany service agreements, and economic substance evidence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection to a French SAS must be routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'INVEST' or 'CAPITAL'. The receiving bank requires a copy of the incorporation documents (Kbis), shareholder resolution, and a certificate of capital deposit from a notary or lawyer. For amounts exceeding EUR 1 million, the bank may request a source of funds declaration. Verification: the bank will verify the sender's identity against the shareholder register. Funds must be credited to a Capital Escrow Account before registration with the RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for trade settlements can be executed via SWIFT MT103 for clean payments or SWIFT MT700 for commercial letters of credit (LC). For routine supplier payments, SEPA transfers are preferred for EU-based suppliers. For non-EU suppliers, SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'TRADE' is standard. The bank may require commercial invoice, bill of lading, and customs declaration (DAU) for amounts above EUR 50,000. Documentary collections (MT400/MT410) are also viable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Foreign exchange forwards (deliverable and non-deliverable) for EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, EUR/GBP.
FX swaps for liquidity management and rolling hedges.
Currency options (vanilla and collar structures) for hedging trade receivables.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted currencies (e.g., CNY, INR, BRL) where deliverable forwards are not available.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for long-term capital hedges.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS) for fiscal years opened on or after 1 January 2022
